Name: Kero replaces Wizard
Author: jengra
Description:
The Wizard is great, but is he the adorable giant-headed bundle of joy that is Kero from Cardcaptor Sakura?

Well now he can be!

This mod replaces all the Wizard's sprites and portraits with Kero. 

[b]Installation instructions:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*]Unzip folder to your Stardew Valley\Mods folder
[*]Enjoy :)
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Kero Replaces Wizard
